ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Highly skewed toward low-intensity pixels; the visible ventral surface is approximately 95% black with discrete high-intensity (white) linear and circular pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary surface consists of a continuous low-intensity black field. High-intensity features include scattered linear vectors (scratches) across the medial lobe regions and dense, contiguous circular white blobs (barnacles) localized at the lateral tips and the lower left leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with an internal angle estimated between 40-50 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency and high-amplitude irregular serrations; distinct jagged peaks and valleys are visible along the entire boundary, with significant 'chip' defects on the upper right lobe (image-right) and upper left lobe (image-left).
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer margins exhibit a concave sweep leading to acute distal tips; the trailing edge follows a broadly convex arc interrupted by significant micro-topographical irregularities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) located at the 9 o'clock and 2 o'clock positions relative to the fluke's lateral extremes, and a small cluster at the 7 o'clock position on the lower margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Dense network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks); prominent parallel scarring visible on the left lobe and intersecting diagonal marks on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive irregular trailing edge erosion/chipping and significant sessile organism colonization (barnacles) on the distal margins.
